# v2.44-dev Release Notes

## Program View-students pop-up now groups people by their training

A refinement of the View-students pop-up on partner-program dashboards.

### Changed

- **One table per training instead of a single mixed list.** The pop-up used to
  show every qualifying person in one table with a "Training" column — which,
  combined with a title that named only the primary requirement, could read as
  though everyone held that one training. It now shows a **separate table for each
  training** (the primary requirement first, then each alternative / variant), each
  under its own heading with a count. The "Training" column is gone, and the pop-up
  title is now simply **Students**, so nothing implies a person holds a training
  they don't.

### Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- Soon-to-expire dates (within 3 months) are still highlighted in red within each
  table. Counts and membership are unchanged.
